s.note: the snacks on the kitchen bench at Play's house
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with celery sticks and 80g blue cheese mashed into a little sour cream.

s.note: the giant sub for the party
s.how: Split a long Italian loaf. Layer with 100g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded iceberg, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with oil and red wine vinegar and season. Press, then cut into thick slices.

m.note: ordered when the party gets hungry
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and dried oregano. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.

w.note: the party that runs all night
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

d.note: the punch bowl in the kitchen
d.how: Freeze 300g pineapple chunks on a tray for 2 hours. In a big bowl, mix 750ml pineapple juice, 500ml orange juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 2 limes. Add a tray of ice and the frozen pineapple. Just before serving, top with 1L cold lemonade and float sliced orange and torn mint on top. Ladle into cups.
